answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a pigment that marks each identity with a real cost. A lone agent pays little, but an attacker spawning an ocean of fake identities must fund each one, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught lying. Legitimate agents earn the stake back at each summit settlement, while fakes lose theirs, so the cost of a Sybil flood scales linearly with its size.
